name: City Weekend Vlog
summary: Turn city footage into a beat-synced 9:16 weekend vlog with a font-switching title, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring, and the host's FileSystem and bundled ffmpeg (Runtime.runFFmpeg) through window.parent.__DI__; no shell, Node.js or other tools.
